title: Persist Dex state so restarting it does not sign everyone out
body:
## Problem
Since 9439197, `compose.yaml` runs Dex for every deployment (local and `compose.public.yaml`). It uses `storage: type: memory` (`sso/dex.yaml`). Recreating the container, including `make sso-reload` after adding an OAuth provider, has two effects:

- Dex generates new signing keys, so every existing SSO session cookie fails verification and users are sent back to the login page.
- In-flight authorization requests are lost.

On a public VM that means every config change or Dex crash signs out the whole organization. Split out of #40, which also covered the template and pinning, both done in 9439197.

## Proposal
- Use Dex's SQLite storage on a named volume (`/var/dex/dex.db`) locally, and Postgres (the existing `postgres` service, a separate `dex` database) in `compose.public.yaml`.
- Keep the rendered config secret-free: pass storage credentials as `$VARS`.
- Document backup of the Dex database next to the platform database.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docker compose up -d --force-recreate dex` keeps an existing SSO browser session valid (Playwright: sign in, recreate Dex, `/api/v1/me` still 200).
- [ ] `tests/test_sso.py` asserts non-memory storage in both the local and public renders.
- [ ] `make sso-reload` no longer signs users out; README and the docs SSO page drop the "signs everyone out" caveat.

title: Verify GitHub, Google, GitLab and Microsoft sign-in against real OAuth apps
body:
## Problem
The GitHub, Google, GitLab and Microsoft connectors in `sso/dex.yaml` (9439197) are verified only by rendering checks in `tests/test_sso.py`. Those tests cover:

- a connector and a login button exist exactly when `KIONGA_*_CLIENT_ID` is set
- the callback is `<issuer>/callback`
- secrets stay `$VARS`

No test has completed a real OAuth round trip with any of them. Untested:

- `KIONGA_GITHUB_ORG` restricting sign-in to org members and turning teams into groups (`org:team`)
- `KIONGA_GOOGLE_HOSTED_DOMAIN`
- `KIONGA_MICROSOFT_TENANT`
- whether each provider's `email_verified` reaches the gateway, which `KIONGA_SIGNUP_EMAIL_DOMAINS` depends on
- that `federated:id` names the connector in sign-up records ("Signed up with github")

## Proposal
- Register test OAuth apps for kiongahq (callback `http://localhost:5556/dex/callback`, plus the public domain's `/dex/callback`).
- Add a manual verification checklist to the docs SSO page, run once per provider and recorded in this issue.
- Optionally add a CI job using repository secrets and a dedicated test account per provider. GitHub can be automated with a bot account; the others likely stay manual because of MFA.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each provider: first sign-in files an access request whose reason names the connector, and `/api/v1/me` shows `connector`.
- [ ] GitHub org restriction rejects a non-member, and a team maps to a role through `KIONGA_SSO_GROUP_ROLES`.
- [ ] Sign-up domain allowlist works with each provider's verified email.
- [ ] Results recorded here, with any connector config fixes landed in `sso/dex.yaml` and the tests.
